item.title: Teen arrested in NSU student's death; second suspect sought
item.description: Louis Anthony Boone, an 18-year-old first-year student at Norfolk State University, was killed in a shooting during a basketball game in Dumfries, Virginia. Four other males were injured, and a 17-year-old juvenile has been charged with felony homicide. Police are searching for J'Shaun Zomari Williams, who is wanted for murder and other charges. The NSU Counseling Center is offering support to students following Boone's death.

item.title: VB Council approves 7 p.m. curfew at Oceanfront beginning Friday
item.description: In a unanimous ruling, the Virginia Beach City Council approved a 7 p.m. emergency curfew for unaccompanied minors at the Oceanfront that will start on Friday, March 13, 2026.

item.title: Wacky weather in Hampton Roads: 4 seasons in one day
item.description: A powerful cold front swept through Hampton Roads on Thursday, causing temperatures to plummet from the 70s into the 40s and bringing snowfall to parts of the region.

item.title: Students 'render gunman no longer alive' after campus shooting that killed 1, injured 2
item.description: Mohamed Jalloh, a man previously convicted of providing ISIL material support and released from prison in 2024, has been identified as the shooter at Old Dominion University Thursday morning. One person was killed and two others hurt in the shooting.
